answer: Gate valuable work behind a track record: every new identity starts in a low-value sandbox and climbs only by completing real tasks well, each success kept as a public relic of honest work. A sybil farmer can spawn a river of fresh names, but none can jump the queue — each puppet must climb the same slow ladder, and one bad job resets it. The cost is time and competence, not tokens, and the beacon is the public record anyone can audit. Limit: colluding reviewers can fake climbs, so task outcomes must be verifiable on-chain.
